clue.text: Look: a little vegetable in spring!

indicators.note: in says the small vegetable sits inside the word for spring

parts.note: to spring is to prance, leap about
a pea is a small green vegetable

explanation.surface: A gardener excitedly spots a tiny pea shoot in springtime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spring' looks like the season, but here it is the verb meaning to leap or bound.
explanation.definitionFit: A look is how something seems to an observer, its outward aspect or air.

clue.text: Charging account supported by United States in heart of Belgium

indicators.note: in a down clue, being supported by puts the account abbreviation above the next piece
heart of picks the central letter of the country's name

explanation.surface: A prosecutor brings charges over an account backed by America, centred in Belgium.
explanation.definitionFit: Charging someone with a crime is formally blaming them, laying an allegation against them.

clue.text: Lyrical American horror writer getting credit mostly

parts.note: Edgar Allan Poe, the American master of macabre tales

indicators.note: mostly says the word for credit loses its final letter

parts.note: on tick means on credit, so tick is a synonym

explanation.surface: A lyrical piece on Poe, the American horror writer, who largely gets the credit.
explanation.definitionFit: Lyrical writing has the expressive, musical qualities of verse.

clue.text: Section of part is tough for performer

indicators.note: Section of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An actor finds a section of the role difficult going.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition took in 'for', which is only the link joining wordplay to definition; the definition is 'performer' alone.
explanation.definitionFit: Artist is a general word for an entertainer such as a singer, dancer or actor.

clue.text: Publicise something; inform about overturned chopped tree

indicators.note: about says the word for inform goes round the other piece

parts.note: to advise someone is to inform them

indicators.note: in a down clue overturned means the shortened tree is read upwards, backwards
chopped says the tree loses its last letter

parts.note: taken as the plain word tree

explanation.surface: Someone is told to spread word about a felled tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chopped' cuts the last letter from the tree; 'overturned' reads the rest upwards, giving ERT; 'about' wraps the word for inform round it.
explanation.definitionFit: To advertise a product is to promote it publicly, making people aware of it.

clue.text: Something small that's charged?

parts.note: reads as a small item with a price, but means a tiny particle carrying negative charge

explanation.walkthrough: 'charged' suggests a bill or fee; in physics it means carrying electric charge.
explanation.definitionFit: This subatomic particle is tiny and carries a negative electrical charge.

clue.text: Announce delivery of mail

definitions.meaning: to put up a notice publicly, make known
the letters and parcels the Royal Mail brings each day

explanation.definitionFit: To post news is to publish it; in Britain the post is the mail itself.

clue.text: Gymnastics expert almost satisfied and calm

parts.note: PE, physical education, school gym lessons
an ace is an expert

indicators.note: almost says the word for satisfied drops its last letter

parts.note: full, as after a big meal

explanation.surface: A gymnastics coach, nearly content, remains composed.
explanation.definitionFit: Calm and tranquil are synonyms describing a mood free of disturbance.

clue.text: Your aim: correct this!

parts.note: reads like an order to fix an error, but describes what a solver hopes to get right in a puzzle

explanation.walkthrough: 'correct' looks like a verb, fix; here it is the adjective, as in the right one.
explanation.definitionFit: The aim of a solver is the correct answer to the clue, the puzzle's resolution.

clue.text: Imaginative chapter concerning Evita returning

parts.note: re means about, concerning

indicators.note: returning means the name Evita is read backwards

explanation.surface: A novel's chapter about Evita making a comeback shows imagination.
explanation.walkthrough: Evita is the musical about Eva Perón; 'returning' gives ATIVE.
explanation.definitionFit: An imaginative person is inventive, full of original ideas.

clue.text: Supply with power?

parts.note: reads as connecting electricity, but means give someone the means or authority to act

explanation.walkthrough: 'power' suggests electricity; the sense is capacity or authority.
explanation.definitionFit: To empower someone is to make them able to do something.

clue.text: Is cross about second source of cuts

indicators.note: about here means jumbled round, signalling a reshuffle of the letters

explanation.surface: Someone is angry about the cause of a series of budget cuts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cross' looks like the anagram signal but is fodder; 'about' rearranges IS and CROSS into SCISSOR, then S for second follows.
explanation.definitionFit: A pair of blades used to cut paper or cloth is what makes the cuts.

clue.text: Agreement to deal with enemy ultimately

parts.note: to treat a matter is to deal with it

indicators.note: ultimately picks the final letter of enemy

explanation.surface: A peace accord is made to deal with the foe at last.
explanation.definitionFit: A treaty is a formal pact between nations.

clue.text: Enthusiastic about piebald horse failing to start

indicators.note: failing to start says the horse word loses its first letter

parts.note: a pinto is a horse with patchy markings

explanation.surface: A rider is keen on a patched horse that refuses to start.
explanation.definitionFit: Being into something informally means being keen on or passionate about it.

clue.text: Select broken and occasionally complex instrument

indicators.note: broken says the letters of select are smashed and rearranged
occasionally picks every other letter of the word complex

explanation.surface: Pick a damaged and sometimes complicated device.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broken' makes TELESC from SELECT; 'occasionally' gives OPE from the alternate letters of complex.
explanation.definitionFit: An optical device of lenses and mirrors that makes distant objects look near.

clue.text: Try daughter with garment not right for Nike?

parts.note: to have a go is to try

indicators.note: not says the garment loses the letter for right

parts.note: a dress is a garment

explanation.surface: A daughter tries on a garment for a sports brand shop.
explanation.walkthrough: Nike looks like the trainer brand; it is the Greek deity of victory, so the question mark flags an example.
explanation.definitionFit: Nike was the Greek winged personification of victory, a female deity.

clue.text: Person running business peeled waterproof off

indicators.note: off means gone wrong, so the remaining letters are rearranged
peeled strips the outer letters from the word waterproof

explanation.surface: A shopkeeper takes off a soaked raincoat.
explanation.definitionFit: A company operator is the one who runs it, managing the enterprise.

clue.text: Calamity as schoolma'am sacrifices millions for diamonds

indicators.note: sacrifices ... for says one letter is given up and another takes its place

parts.note: a schoolmistress, shortened to mistress, is a female teacher
D stands for diamonds, the card suit

explanation.surface: Disaster as a teacher gives up a fortune for jewels.
explanation.definitionFit: Distress here is grave misfortune or trouble, a sense close to a disaster.

clue.text: Clearly defined brief theorising whenever in command

parts.note: spec is the short form of speculation
if can mean whenever, as in if it rains, I stay in
IC means in charge, in command

explanation.surface: A precise summary of theories about whenever someone is in command.
explanation.definitionFit: Specific means precise, exactly stated, not vague.

clue.text: Good unfinished narrow road in close country

indicators.note: in says the road pieces go inside the word for close

parts.note: the close of something is its end

indicators.note: unfinished says the road loses its last letter

parts.note: a lane is a narrow road

explanation.surface: A good rural lane, unfinished, close to the countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: England is a nation within the United Kingdom.

clue.text: Managed, having been shown the way

definitions.meaning: ran, oversaw, as of a project or film
guided, given instructions on the route

explanation.definitionFit: Directed means supervised, and also pointed or guided toward a destination.

clue.text: Reportedly ring for cover?

indicators.note: reportedly says we hear the word, so a word sounding the same is entered

parts.note: a peal is the ringing of bells

explanation.surface: Apparently someone calls to ask for shelter.
explanation.definitionFit: The skin or rind of a fruit is its protective outer layer.

clue.text: Inferior bibles sermoniser purchases

indicators.note: purchases means takes in, so the words hold the answer within them

explanation.surface: A poor-quality Bible bought by a preacher.
explanation.definitionFit: Lesser means smaller in importance or worse in quality.

clue.text: Dreamy sailor roused to ecstasy

parts.note: AB, able seaman, a rating in the navy
sent is old slang for thrilled, carried away

explanation.surface: A daydreaming sailor is carried away in rapture.
explanation.definitionFit: An absent air is distracted, lost in thought, far away.

clue.text: Bitterly cold truck transporting ice essentially

indicators.note: transporting says the lorry carries the other letter inside it

parts.note: artic is British slang for an articulated lorry

indicators.note: essentially picks the central letter of ice

explanation.surface: A lorry hauls ice through freezing weather.
explanation.definitionFit: Polar conditions are freezing, so the word describes extreme chill.

clue.text: Gather, taking walk around South London area

indicators.note: taking says the walk word takes in other letters
around says the walk word goes round the other pieces

parts.note: to amble is to walk leisurely
SE is the postal district for south-east London

explanation.surface: People congregate, strolling through south London.
explanation.definitionFit: To assemble is to come together, convene in one place.

clue.text: Cunningly stifle the very thing

indicators.note: cunningly means artfully, so the letters of stifle are craftily rearranged

explanation.surface: Slyly suppress the precise thing.
explanation.definitionFit: Used for emphasis, as in kindness personified, this word means the very thing.

clue.text: Most clamorous one interrupting most prying

indicators.note: interrupting says the numeral breaks into the other word

parts.note: nosiest means most inquisitive
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A loud person butts in on the most inquisitive neighbour.
explanation.definitionFit: Clamorous means loud, so the superlative names the loudest.

clue.text: Items stored by Arsenal members

definitions.meaning: weapons, as kept in an arsenal
limbs, as in the body's upper ones

explanation.walkthrough: Arsenal looks like the London football club; here it is a weapons store.
explanation.definitionFit: Arms are weapons, and are also the upper limbs of the body.

clue.text: Famous rebel acted badly

indicators.note: badly says the letters of the two words are performed in poor order, rearranged

explanation.surface: A renowned rebel gave a poor performance.
explanation.definitionFit: Celebrated means renowned, widely praised.
